cards.name: 🎤 Voice
cards.now: Daily voice routine, about 15 min: Regulate → Release → Build

routine.credit: Release exercises from @thesomaticscientist (instagram.com/thesomaticscientist). Gentle pressure only, never push through pain.

steps.title: Regulate
steps.text: Stand tall, soft knees. 4 breaths: in through the nose for 4, out on a long 'sss' for 8. Then warm-fog breath ×3: tongue tip on the roof just behind your top teeth, open the jaw at the BACK like a yawn, breathe in through the nose, out slow warm air like fogging a mirror. Feel under the tongue and throat soften.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: Under-jaw (inner jaw) release: elbows on a table, thumbs under the chin, trace to the jaw corners, slide just inside the jawbone and let your head rest on your hands. Hold a tender spot ~30 sec a side until it softens (a yawn or saliva means it worked). Then slow jaw glides, then the side-of-neck release. Finish with 5 easy yawn-sighs, high to low.

pick.label: Rotate in 1–2 per day (swap, don't add, so this stays 3 min):

items.t: Hyoid release (for pitch): tongue heavy like sand, jaw loose, nose breathing. Feel the hyoid tips between thumb and finger, rest in the soft space below it, then above it. Very gentle, not a place to push. 1–2 min.

Front-of-neck (platysma): one hand gently presses in and down on the collarbone while the chin slowly lifts ×2. Then hands crossed on the upper chest, shoulders down, look up gently. Then the same with the tongue suctioned to the roof. Until you sigh or yawn.
Open the back of the mouth: 'cat claw' circles on the temples, then stroke down the masseter (cheekbone to jaw) with the mouth open. 30–60 sec a side.
SCM pincer walk + 'ice cream scoop' behind the ear: tilt ear to shoulder, gently pinch the whole rope muscle and walk up and down ~1 min, then scoop behind the ear. Both sides.

steps.title: Breath control
steps.text: One breath, steady quiet 'sss' hiss. Time it and note the seconds. Then 3 rounds of 'fff' pulses: 4 short kicks + 1 long. This is what fixes running out at the ends of lines.

steps.title: Warm the sound
steps.text: Lip trill or straw hum sliding 5-4-3-2-1 down, starting around C4, moving up by half steps. Stop before it strains. Then 'ng' (as in 'sing') sirens, low → high → low, quiet and smooth.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Sing 1-2-3-4-5-4-3-2-1 on 'mee', then 'mah', with space between the back teeth (open the back, not the front). Medium volume, never push.

links.t: 😮 Open the back of the mouth (IG)
👅 Bonus: tongue release for high notes (IG)

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: One song line. Mark where you'll breathe. Sing it at 70% effort, then with full feeling and the same ease.

tired.text: Steps 1, 2 and 4 only. It still counts. ✅ Super-short option: the 13-second ear and jaw sweep, a few rounds (glide in front of the ear, sweep down behind it, gently pull the ear out).

watch.t: 🧠 Watch once: 'Your nervous system state is your sound' (IG)

test.when: Once a week, same day, same time
test.baseline: Range A3–A4 · about 21 cents off on average · breath fades at the ends of lines
test.targets: In 12 weeks: wider easy range · pitch within 10–15 cents · strong line endings
